views.label: Python to C++
views.note: The injected __add__ finishes scalar coercion and dtype promotion, then hands off to pybind11.

views.label: Validation and schema
views.note: BinaryKernel checks dtype, device and shape; SchemaGuard settles determinism and the AMP dtype.

views.label: CPU and GPU compute
views.note: Dispatcher picks the backend by Device. CPU computes now; GPU only adds a graph node.

views.label: Autograd recording
views.note: The output TensorImpl is built, and an AddBackward node becomes its grad_fn only when needed.

messages.label: _C_engine.add
messages.note: _unwrap_or_scalar turns b into a TensorImpl and _maybe_promote aligns dtypes before the call

messages.label: SchemaGuard
messages.note: Dtype and device mismatches are rejected first; then determinism is checked and AMP picks the autocast dtype

messages.label: for_device(dev)
messages.note: Indexes an array by the Device enum; 'metal' maps to Device.GPU

messages.label: CPU: vDSP_vadd
messages.note: Takes the output buffer from the pool and computes synchronously

messages.label: GPU: mlx add
messages.note: mlx::core::add only adds a graph node; the math runs at eval() or item()

messages.label: new TensorImpl
messages.note: Wraps the Storage with the broadcast shape; no AutogradMeta yet

messages.label: AddBackward node
messages.note: Only when GradMode is on and an input requires grad

messages.label: TensorImplPtr
messages.note: Crosses pybind11 as a shared_ptr, no copy

cards.title: One object, three roles
items: AddBackward is the op, the BinaryKernel (CRTP) and the autograd node at once
a + b skips the _ops registry: the injected __add__ calls the engine directly

cards.title: CPU vs GPU
items: CPU: vDSP_vadd computes on the spot
GPU: mlx::core::add only adds a node; it runs at .item() or eval()

cards.title: Where it is rejected
items: C++ never promotes dtypes; Python aligns them first
